assetStatus: Already implemented — a hand-built React Three Fiber scene (EarthSpaceViewer.tsx, mode="motion"), not a pending asset. Earth renders from the same real, already-cleared GLB used by the Solar System branch (see src/data/planets.ts's earth entry and modelRegistry.ts for provenance/license).
visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow/bloom. Earth orbits a small Sun marker on a thin ring while spinning independently on its own tilted-free axis for this mode; the lit hemisphere tracks the Sun direction in real time via directional lighting, not a texture swap.
materialNotes: Earth uses its existing real GLB material set (metallic-roughness PBR); no emissive channels — day/night is real-time directional lighting, not a baked day/night texture.
note: Unlike the hotspot-on-a-body pattern used by Moons/Stars/Galaxies, this branch is process-driven: the 'Touch it' interaction is a live physics simulation (independent rotation/revolution speed sliders) rather than tapping points on a single model, so this component intentionally carries no hotspots — the simulation itself is the interactive surface.
